notice: Invented teaching fixtures, not client results or Google indexing evidence.

cases.title: A launch page is blocked from crawling
cases.finding: The wildcard crawler group disallows every path, including /trail-guide/.
cases.fix: Remove the accidental site-wide disallow only after confirming the page is intended to be public.
cases.acceptance: The fixture rule allows Googlebot to fetch /trail-guide/. This checks crawl permission, not indexing.

cases.title: An intended public page still has noindex
cases.finding: The HTML robots meta tag contains noindex.
cases.fix: Remove the unintended directive at its source. Check both HTML metadata and response headers in production.
cases.acceptance: The fixed HTML and modeled headers contain no noindex directive. Google indexing remains unverified.

cases.title: The sitemap route returns an app shell
cases.finding: The modeled response is HTTP 200 with an HTML body, not the promised XML sitemap.
cases.fix: Serve the sitemap before a catch-all HTML route; return sitemap XML and an appropriate XML content type.
cases.acceptance: The fixed fixture parses as a sitemap urlset with one absolute URL. No submission or crawl is claimed.

cases.title: Two canonical tags disagree
cases.finding: Two canonical link elements point to different URLs for the same page.
cases.fix: Choose the intended representative page and emit one consistent canonical. Keep the sitemap aligned.
cases.acceptance: Exactly one canonical remains and matches the fixture sitemap URL. Google-selected canonical remains unverified.
